instruction: Cinematic portrait of a couple in front of a blue-grey marble wall. The woman in the white sweater (R2) wears a beige hat and stands in the foreground, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. The bearded man in the brown sweater (R1) stands behind her to the right, wearing a brown hat and round glasses, looking off-camera. He wraps his right arm around her shoulder, and she rests her hand on his. Soft, natural lighting highlights their warm-toned clothing against the cool, textured background.
